checks.name: Flutter analyzer and full test suite
checks.observation: All 174 tests passed; analyzer reported no issues. Audio coverage verifies refresh queuing, stale successful scan rejection, stale failed scan suppression after hotplug, and error/loading cleanup.

checks.name: Hotplug supersedes an obsolete scan failure
checks.command: flutter test test/app_state_test.dart --plain-name 'does not show a stale scan error after a newer hotplug event'
checks.observation: A newer hotplug snapshot remains selected and the obsolete asynchronous scan failure does not replace it with an error.

checks.reason: The build host exposed no CoreAudio devices (_items was empty), and no physical Windows or Android test device was available. This cannot validate device labels, permission-gated enumeration, hotplug, or audible switching.

remaining: Install the release APK and test microphone grant/re-enumeration, named devices, hotplug, switching, PTT, and local/remote screen-share return with real peers on macOS, Windows, and Android.
